name: Church Security
overview: Scripture underscores the importance of vigilance and prayer in maintaining church security, as seen in Nehemiah's example of setting a watch while praying to God (Nehemiah 4:9). It acknowledges human limitations and the challenges faced in protecting the community (Nehemiah 4:10), while also emphasizing prudence in anticipating danger (Proverbs 22:3). God promises protection against adversaries (Isaiah 54:17), and Jesus instructs preparedness and defense (Luke 11:21; 22:36), illustrating that spiritual and practical measures together safeguard the church.
